en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a panel that controls the alarm system
and electric barrier.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't see any reason to turn
them back on, though...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
I don't think I'll ever get used to seeing it.

<CLT=cltMIND>The alarm system was deactivated
by Monokuma.
